definition: Whether the value was printed in the source or read off a plotted figure
notes: always 'digitised_from_figure' in this item. Digitisation: the left panel of Fig. 7 was pixel-digitised from a 200-ppi bilevel page scan by Heffner_etal_1994_c_Figure7_extract.py. In this figure the two-letter species CODES are the plotted symbols and a round dot appears only where a code was displaced. Estimated error: the abscissa ticks are not evenly log-spaced on this scan, so x carries a calibration spread of -10.9% to +10.5% (y: -1.9% to +1.5%); on top of that, a code-anchored position may be displaced from its datum by up to about one character -- checked against this paper's own Table 1, the six dot-anchored species agree to within 2.7% while the five code-anchored species scatter by -40.9% to +11.6%. The panel contains 29 plotted species; 13 sit on 8 printed dots (five dots are shared by two species each, so those positions are INFERRED from a shared marker) and the remaining 16 are located only by their printed code. The right panel plots residuals (a derived quantity) and was not digitised.
